items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Then you did some Luis Gasca session, and then a Nat Adderley, Calling Out Loud, and then Walter Wanderley. ... Yeah, I remember that. That was Creed Taylor. I remember doing it.

ctx.x: No, but it might be a different session, because of the chronology. Then you did some Luis Gasca session, and then a Nat Adderley, Calling Out Loud, and then Walter Wanderley.
Walter Wanderley. Yeah, I remember that. That was Creed Taylor. I remember doing it.
Then there’s an A&M recording with Milton Nascimento. It’s got everybody in there.
